reminders.title: Arrive on time
reminders.text: Please arrive on time for the 5:00 PM start.

reminders.title: Proper attire
reminders.text: Please wear proper attire appropriate for KADIWA Formal.

reminders.title: Photos and videos
reminders.text: Please refrain from posting photos or videos of the event on social media until the official activity has aired on the official Church pages.

directions.title: From One-North MRT
steps: Exit One-North MRT (CC23) and follow the signs toward One-North Park.
Walk toward and along One-North Park, keeping the park on your route.
Continue along the pedestrian path toward One-North Link.
Follow the path toward Slim Barracks Rise, then turn onto Slim Barracks Rise.
Continue until you reach No. 11, NTU@one-north.

directions.title: From Buona Vista MRT
steps: At Buona Vista MRT, take Exit D.
Follow the pedestrian path toward North Buona Vista Road.
Walk along North Buona Vista Road toward the MOE building.
Continue past the MOE area. NTU@one-north is behind the MOE building.
Continue until you reach No. 11, NTU@one-north. The building is on your right when approaching from Buona Vista MRT.
